h1: Go Microservice Starter with Gin, gRPC, Wire & Docker
includes: Gin (HTTP) + gRPC (grpc-gateway) — single server, dual protocol
Google Wire for compile-time dependency injection
golangci-lint (errcheck, govet, staticcheck, gosec, revive, etc.)
GitHub Actions: vet, lint, test -race, build, docker
go.mod with pinned dependencies and replace directives for Wire
Generated README with make targets and project structure

faq.q: Why Wire for DI instead of manual wiring?
faq.a: Wire generates code at compile time — no runtime reflection, no startup overhead, and compile-time safety.

faq.q: Does it include a database layer (GORM, sqlx)?
faq.a: The template shows a repository pattern interface. Add your preferred ORM/driver after generation.
The template uses a simple config struct with environment variables. Extend with Viper if needed.

faq.q: Can I use this for a monolith instead of microservice?
faq.a: Yes — the structure works for any Go service. Remove the gRPC parts if HTTP-only.
